Maya (Design): dropped a quick GIF of run history with compact rows + tool badges: https://figma.com/file/abc/run-history-compact Maya (Design): problem: when many calls run, users miss structured outputs behind collapsed rows. want better glanceability without expanding everything. Leo (DevEx): saw a support ticket — customer couldn't find the parsed CSV after a batch run. We should add micro-metadata inline (type + small count) so scan = success. Priya (Frontend): perf note: adding micro-metadata to every row might increase paint. We can virtualize + lazy-hydrate badges when row is visible. Noah (Eng-ML): streaming case: tool emits rows progressively. If summary shows counts, it should reflect final count only when complete, otherwise show an interim spinner next to the badge. Jules (QA): accessibility: ensure the summary button has aria-expanded and the expanded region gets focus on open. keyboard users need predictable focus movement. A11y-bot: recommendation: summary button aria-controls -> details id; details role=region with aria-label referencing tool friendly name; avoid auto focus trap. Maya (Design): copy idea: instead of "Table extracted", show "excel_extract table • 3 rows" where the middle dot separates pieces. compact and scannable. Leo (DevEx): +1. telemetry: events `run_history_row_expand`, `run_history_badge_hover`. add debounce on streaming to avoid analytics spam. Priya (Frontend): mock DOM proposal: ```html 
{...}
``` Priya (Frontend): implementation plan: virtualize list, hydrate details on open; badges are lightweight spans; streaming badge shows spinner state. ETA 3 days. Noah (Eng-ML): UX add: inline schema hint on hover for the badge showing columns & sample row. helps users decide whether to expand. Maya (Design): I like hover preview. Keep it short: "cols: name, qty, price" or "schema: 4 cols" for very dense lists. Jules (QA): test matrix I'll run: keyboard expand/collapse, screen reader order (summary -> badge -> payload), streaming partial announcements (no double reads). Also test copy on huge payloads. A11y-bot: note: when streaming, use aria-live polite only for completion status ("3 rows extracted") not for every chunk. rate-limit announcements. Leo (DevEx): copy UX: when user clicks copy for big JSON, show toast "Payload copied" with action "Open" (opens details). reduces extra clicks. Priya (Frontend): copy impl: use navigator.clipboard.writeText; if payload > 1MB, chunk copy off main thread or fallback to background worker. Maya (Design): for filters above the history, propose compact pill bar: "Tools ▾ Types ▾ Time ▾" -> concise and consistent with other consoles. Noah (Eng-ML): compatibility: mark very old runs as "legacy" with gray pill so users know metadata might be missing. Jules (QA): add tests for legacy badge + tooltip copy. also narrow width/responsive wrapping. Maya (Design): quick poll: react :thumbsup: for explicit summary (tool · type · count) or :eyes: for minimal (tool · type). Maya (Design): :thumbsup: Priya (Frontend): :thumbsup: Noah (Eng-ML): :eyes: (lean minimal in dense logs) Jules (QA): :thumbsup: Leo (DevEx): :thumbsup: Maya (Design): cool — I'll upload final mocks + a 5-step test script later today and tag QA.
